name: crewser
description: Run several Claude Code sessions as one crew: roles, models and strategies, pings between sessions, an overseer for several crews, and a pixel-art town to watch them work.

showBand.title: Show the usage bars
showBand.description: Draw the context and usage-limit bars.

barsPosition.title: Bars position
barsPosition.description: below = under the prompt, on the hint line; above = in the band above the prompt.

showCost.title: Cost
showCost.description: Show this session's cost in USD.

barColors.title: Bar colors
barColors.description: traffic = green/yellow/red by fill, session = this session's color, mono = theme text.

autoName.title: Apply name and color
autoName.description: When a session starts or joins a task, run /rename with its name and /color with its color.

colorTarget.title: Session color goes to
colorTarget.description: prompt = Claude's prompt bar via /color (8 colors), background = tint the terminal (Terminal.app background, iTerm2 tab), both, or none.

tintStrength.title: Tint strength
tintStrength.description: How strongly the background is tinted, in percent (0-60).

flashOnPing.title: Flash background on ping
flashOnPing.description: Pulse the terminal background while a ping waits, even when the session color goes to the prompt bar.

macNotify.title: macOS notifications
macNotify.description: Post a macOS notification when a ping arrives while the window is not focused.

autoKickoff.title: Auto kickoff on join
autoKickoff.description: After joining a task, start a turn that introduces this session to the team.

strategiesFolder.title: Strategies folder
strategiesFolder.description: Where strategies are saved. Empty = in the project, in .crewser/strategies (committed and shared with the code). Or a folder on this machine, e.g. ~/crewser/strategies.

townFolder.title: Town folder
townFolder.description: Where the town's buildings are saved. Empty = in the project, in .crewser/town (committed and merged with the code). Or a folder on this machine, e.g. ~/crewser/towns (a folder per project inside it).

autoOpen.title: Town: Open the town at start
autoOpen.description: Open the town pane when a session starts (it seats once the terminal is wide enough).

boredAfter.title: Town: Bored after (seconds)
boredAfter.description: When every member idles and you have been away this long, the crew starts waving for work.

height.title: Town: Height
height.description: Rows the town asks for when it sits above the prompt (14-60).
